external_narratives.summary: Detailed page on Flt Lt Stanislaw Roman Madej and the loss of 307 Squadron Mosquito XII E HK194 EW-L. On 18 September 1944, returning from Operation Market Garden at 400 metres altitude, HK194 was struck from underneath by another 307 Squadron Mosquito HK228 and crashed at Withcall Station at 20:01 hours.
key_details: Pilot Flt Lt Madej was 27 years old, Polish Air Force
Navigator F/O Gasecki was 25 years old, Polish Air Force
Aircraft struck from below by Mosquito HK228 of same squadron
HK228 crew (Flt Lt Griffiths and Flt Lt Lane) survived the collision
Crash occurred at Withcall Station at 20:01 hrs
Aircraft was returning from Operation Market Garden support operations

memorial_details:
Name: 307 Polish Night Fighter Squadron R.A.F - De Havilland Mosquito HK194
Type: Cross
Description: A rough hewn cross made from three pieces of stone standing on a concrete slab base. The inscription and dedication is incised onto two slate tablets mounted on the front face. See WMR reference 98191 for further information
Inscription: Top tablet: (Badge of No. 307 City of Lwów Polish Night Fighter Squadron Royal Air Force) Bottom tablet: In Honour/ and memory of/ the aircrew of/ 307 Squadron/ Polish Air Force/ Mosquito Plane Crash/ returning from/ Operation/ Market Garden/ Arneham, Netherlands/ World War II - 18.9.1944/ Pilot/ Fl/Lt Stanislaw Roman/ Madej/ Aged 27 years/ Navigator/ F/O Jozef Stanislaw/ Gasecki/ Aged 25 years/ Let the sky and/ God be their/ Limit and Eternity/ their measurement
Location: Along a Private track from the end of Station road and Home Farm. Station Road Withcall East Lindsey Lincolnshire LN11 9RL England
Grid Ref: TF 27953 83383
Coordinates: 53.331896473475,-0.080029440597
Photos: https://media.iwm.org.uk/ciim5/memorials/122/97/large_mosquito_crash_memorial_.jpg; https://media.iwm.org.uk/ciim5/memorials/122/98/large_mosquito_hk194_inscription.jpg; https://media.iwm.org.uk/ciim5/memorials/122/99/large_mosquito_crash_memorial_in_context_b.jpg; https://media.iwm.org.uk/ciim5/memorials/122/100/large_mosquito_crash_memorial_oblique.jpg; https://media.iwm.org.uk/ciim5/memorials/122/101/large_mosquito_crash_memorial_in_context_a.jpg

This memorial was established by Jean Howard in January 1980.

Memorial Dedication: The memorial commemorates the crash of a De Havilland Mosquito HK194 belonging to the 307 Polish Night Fighter Squadron R.A.F.

Opening of 307 Squadron exhibition (24 March): Display of historical artifacts and information at Farringdon Village Hall

Closing of 307 Squadron exhibition (24 March): End of the historical exhibition at Farringdon Village Hall

Unveiling of the memorial (24 March): Commemoration event outside Farringdon Village Hall
narrative: Returning from Operation Market Garden over Arnhem on 18 September 1944, Mosquito HK194 of 307 (Polish) Squadron was involved in a mid-air collision with a second squadron aircraft, Mosquito HK228, during the flight back to Church Fenton. The aircraft came down at Withcall, Lincolnshire, killing both men aboard. Pilot Flight Lieutenant Stanislaw Roman Madej, aged 27, and his navigator Flying Officer Jozef Stanislaw Gasecki, aged 25, were both Polish airmen serving with the RAF. There were no survivors. Both men are among the Polish aircrew commemorated at the memorial site at Withcall.
